# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos gives no separate existence to plan and deed when both serve truth;
Awtsmoos.com will rewrite whole files, preserve the public doorway, and prove the shelf anew in every route of youth.

## Source files to write

- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/ui/bookshelf.js`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/ui/bookshelf/TiferesBookshelfView.js`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/ui/bookshelf/MalchusBookshelfCardFactory.js`

- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/styles/runtime/bookshelf-interaction.css`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/styles/runtime-ui.css`

## Test shadow work after code

- Add one Bookshelf source/style ownership contract.
- Add one Bookshelf public API/safe-DOM contract.
- Rerun all Rebbe tests.
- Start a new preview server only after source/test closure.

## Completion condition for this node

Bookshelf closes only when the runtime style factory is gone, all bookmark data enters through safe DOM, interaction/mobile style ownership is static and local, every touched source is <=120 lines, the complete Rebbe suite is green, and fresh route load is proven.
